Device Name
Route 92 Medical 088 Access System
Indications for Use (Describe)
The Route 92 Medical 088 Access System, 110 cm, is indicated for use with compatible guide catheters in facilitating the
insertion and guidance of microcatheters into a selected blood vessel in the neurovascular system.
